ref.description: Reference to the other obj than the owning one in a timed relation.

title:
Used to hold other ref in the latest TimedRelation in owning entity.  This is useful when storing the latest value of a timed relation on either the from or to
objs and tying it to a timed relation field via the {@link Db.timedValueHistoryField} annotation. This enables using the same field to reference the other side
of the relation regardless of whether the owning obj is the {@link TimedRelation.from} or {@link TimedRelation.to} reference.
name: TimedRelationRef
